exercises.instruction: Choose the correct superlative adjective to complete the sentence.
exercises.prompt: Mount Everest is ___ mountain in the world.
exercises.explanation: High is one syllable → the + -est. 'The most highest' is a double superlative error. 'Highest' without 'the' is incorrect.

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct superlative adjective to complete the sentence.
exercises.prompt: That was ___ film I have ever seen.
exercises.explanation: Good → best (irregular superlative). This uses the superlative + present perfect pattern.

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct superlative adjective to complete the sentence.
exercises.prompt: This is ___ project our team has ever completed.
exercises.explanation: Ambitious has four syllables → the most + adjective. Always include 'the' before the superlative.

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct superlative adjective to complete the sentence.
exercises.prompt: Jakarta is ___ city in Indonesia.
exercises.explanation: Large is one syllable (ends in -e) → the + -st. Always include 'the.'

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct superlative adjective to complete the sentence.
exercises.prompt: He is ___ student the professor has ever taught.
exercises.explanation: Bright is one syllable → the + -est. 'The most brightest' is a double superlative error.

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct superlative adjective to complete the sentence.
exercises.prompt: Borobudur is one of ___ temples in Southeast Asia.
exercises.explanation: Beautiful has four syllables → the most + adjective. The noun 'temples' follows in the sentence. Always include 'the.'

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct superlative adjective to complete the sentence.
exercises.prompt: That was ___ decision he has ever made.
exercises.explanation: Bad → worst (irregular superlative). 'The most bad' and 'the most worse' are errors.

exercises.instruction: Identify the sentence that contains an error.
exercises.prompt: Which sentence is incorrect?
options: She is the most dedicated employee in the company.
He is most intelligent student I have ever met.
That was the worst meal I have ever eaten.
This is one of the most important decisions we will make.
exercises.answer: He is most intelligent student I have ever met.
exercises.explanation: Superlatives always need 'the' — 'the most intelligent student.' Missing 'the' is the error.

exercises.instruction: Identify the sentence that contains an error.
exercises.prompt: Which sentence is incorrect?
options: Bali is one of the most popular tourist destinations in the world.
She is one of the best researcher in the department.
He is one of the most experienced doctors at the hospital.
This is one of the hardest courses offered by the university.
exercises.answer: She is one of the best researcher in the department.
exercises.explanation: 'One of the + superlative' must be followed by a plural noun — 'researchers,' not 'researcher.'

exercises.instruction: Identify the sentence that contains an error.
exercises.prompt: Which sentence is incorrect?
options: That is the most difficult question I have ever answered.
She is the most happy person I know.
This is the fastest car in the showroom.
He is the best candidate for the job.
exercises.answer: She is the most happy person I know.
exercises.explanation: Happy ends in -y → change y to i + -est → the happiest. 'The most happy' is incorrect.

exercises.instruction: Identify the sentence that contains an error.
exercises.prompt: Which sentence is incorrect?
options: Bali is the most beautiful island I have ever visited.
This is the most expensive hotel in the city.
Bali is the most beautiful island I never visited.
He is the most talented musician she has ever heard.
exercises.answer: Bali is the most beautiful island I never visited.
exercises.explanation: In the superlative + present perfect pattern, use 'ever' not 'never': 'the most beautiful island I have ever visited.'

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct superlative form to complete the sentence.
exercises.prompt: The ___ exam I have ever taken was the IELTS writing section.
exercises.explanation: Hard is one syllable → the + -est. 'Most hardest' is a double superlative error.

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct superlative form to complete the sentence.
exercises.prompt: Of all the students, she works ___.
exercises.explanation: Hard is a short one-syllable adjective → the hardest. 'The most hard' is incorrect. Always include 'the.'

exercises.instruction: Identify the sentence that contains an error.
exercises.prompt: Which sentence is incorrect?
options: He is one of the most productive employees in the office.
She is one of the best scientists in the country.
Komodo dragons are one of the most endangered animal in the world.
This is one of the most creative solutions I have seen.
exercises.answer: Komodo dragons are one of the most endangered animal in the world.
exercises.explanation: 'One of the + superlative' must be followed by a plural noun — 'animals,' not 'animal.'

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct superlative form to complete the question.
exercises.prompt: What is ___ river in Indonesia?
exercises.explanation: Long is one syllable → the + -est. Always include 'the' in superlative questions.

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct superlative form to complete the question.
exercises.prompt: Is this ___ course the department has ever offered?
exercises.explanation: Popular has three syllables → the most + adjective. Always include 'the.'

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct superlative form to complete the question.
exercises.prompt: Who is ___ player on the national team?
exercises.explanation: Good → best (irregular superlative). Always include 'the.'

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct superlative form to complete the question.
exercises.prompt: Which of these three options is ___?
exercises.explanation: Practical has three syllables → the most + adjective. Always include 'the.'

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct superlative form to complete the question.
exercises.prompt: What was ___ challenge you faced during the project?
exercises.explanation: Big is one syllable, consonant-vowel-consonant → double g + -est → the biggest. Always include 'the.'

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct superlative structure.
exercises.prompt: She is one of the ___ in the country.
exercises.explanation: 'One of the + superlative + plural noun' — the noun must be plural: 'scientists,' not 'scientist.'
